_comment: Listing-gate policy. Edit here, not in the rule code. No secrets.
parked_markers: make an offer on this domain
_provenance_comment: A bot-verified record (a discord_exempt_kinds kind, or any record whose provenance.validated.method is in bot_stamp_methods) may be added or changed only by a PR whose GitHub author is in intake_pr_authors. intake.yml opens its PR with github.token, so GitHub sets that author to github-actions[bot]; no person can hold that login. CI runs the gate and this file from the PR's BASE commit, so a PR cannot add its own author here.
_no_url_exempt_comment: Kinds whose entry legitimately has no page: gate/world are route/namespace entries, discord/community are bot-verified invites. A url-less record of any other kind fails the url rules.
